deduplication_rules: NP01 is both the full-window diagnostic and nominal coarse cell; do not add a second nominal coarse run.
The nominal amplitude spatial cells are reused within the three-amplitude control matrix; endpoint expansion adds six cells, not nine.
Full-window runs provide identical-protocol short-window prefixes, so no additional fine short-window solver attempts are counted.

NP03 and NP04 remain distinct under the current single-factor control plan. Combining changed integration and output settings requires a prospective equivalence justification that does not currently exist.

conditional_dependencies_and_limits: A passing NP01 hard audit alone does not establish the numerical recipe, control domain, material reference or production readiness.
No matrix cell is launchable through this document. Additional preparation, dependency checks, actual budget guards and applicable authorization remain separate.
The minimum assumes every new run passes on its first attempt and dp=.010 is qualified for production under the complete registered ladder and observation protocol.

If dp=.0075 becomes the production candidate, use an independent internal comparison at .0075/.006 and establish time/output/zero-drive evidence applicable to that production recipe. Prospective reassignment of unlaunched controls may avoid duplication; already completed diagnostics cannot automatically certify the replacement recipe.

If dp=.006 is selected for production, it cannot act as its own finer reference. Further finer-resolution evidence and a prospectively revised matrix are required; no exact extra count is claimed here.
Changing CFL or CoefDtMin without a demonstrated native integration-step reduction does not complete the temporal gate. Failure may require additional evidence-led work beyond the minimum.

Native NoPen velocity/displacement corrections require their numerical and material-path semantics to be documented, including available trigger, correction and momentum/energy evidence. If existing native outputs are insufficient, additional diagnostics or reruns are not included in this zero-reserve minimum.
Failed attempts, timeouts, input errors and guarded stops remain charged; qualification work may not be relabelled as development.
A cap of 65 would cover only this conditional zero-reserve minimum. It is not current authorization, and the pending cap-64 proposal has no approval.

reusable_engineering_and_protocol_eviden: Frozen v2 observation design and unchanged manufactured calibration, subject to source/hash checks.
Verified native control interpretation, gravity-preserving amplitude definition and fixed tank coordinate convention.
Exactly unchanged CELL3 initial fluid/boundary assets, normals and dp-specific physical-volume checks, subject to new input/hash verification.
Existing readers, hard audits, finite-wall geometry and timestep/output diagnostic methods after confirming applicability to the new recipe.
Historical failures remain valid negative evidence and may inform hypotheses; they are never rewritten as passing data.
old_cfd_not_qualification_credit: NoPen=0 NS1 nominal, half-step, quarter-step and dp=.0075 quarter-step full-window cases failed the nominal-wall crossing hard gate.
The old passing gravity-only case used a different boundary recipe; no proof establishes complete dynamical equivalence to NoPen=1.
The old short-window canary does not certify the new NoPen full-window recipe or domain.
Earlier velocity-zero, no-slip-with-zero-boundary-viscosity and CELL2 results cannot replace any new NoPen spatial, time, output or control-domain cell.
NoPen changes native velocity and displacement. Old convergence evidence and the old no_projection recipe label must not be inherited as new qualification.

full_goal_status.objective: 取得一份可复现的F3数值参考配方，明确其分辨率、控制范围、时间窗、坐标系和可评分任务；随后实际生成独立开发数据，并完成材料与学习闭环。
full_goal_status.material_rule: Qualified CFD may supply common physical seeds and cross-dp material comparisons, but macro convergence, manufactured tracer checks and substep convergence do not prove full-window material paths. Material configurations use their own remaining 32-total cap.
full_goal_status.development_rule: After T1 recipe, domain and input/split gates, execute the actual registered eight-case pilot and then the independent development expansion within the existing 40-attempt cap. T1-only development need not wait for T2-path.
full_goal_status.learning_rule: Complete real training for two routes and three seeds, autonomous failure/score panels, recovery and measured costs within the existing 12-attempt cap. Engineering-only forwards are not training or qualification.

source_plan_evidence.use: Prior same-family matrix structure only; its NoPen=0 recipe is not reused as NoPen=1 qualification
